summary_md: **Faheem | FrontierMind AI ([@cooolernemesis](https://x.com/cooolernemesis/status/2115126983763911019))** cites *Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses*: on Terminal-Bench subsets across seven coding models, independent review improved average accuracy by 5.9–9.5 points at 1.13–1.25x baseline API cost, framing review design as a test-time scaling choice.
relevance: Quantifies the value of a reviewer step in a harness.
